title: Lead visitors from the index into project evidence
context: The homepage index depended on preview availability and large covers opened the external product, bypassing its case study.
options: Keep preview availability coupled to index membership and covers linked to live products
Keep every listing and route published covers to their case study
choice: Separate index membership from preview availability, link published covers to the case study, and load deeper tools on action.
tradeoff: Missing previews need an explicit placeholder; live products remain a separate link.
